property_summary: For any inputs to initialize, the contract's virtualBaseTokenReserves equals the _virtualBaseTokenReserves argument after initialize completes; the mutant sets virtualBaseTokenReserves to _virtualNftReserves instead, so for inputs where _virtualBaseTokenReserves != _virtualNftReserves the mutant will violate this property.
change_summary: Change assignment to virtualBaseTokenReserves to assign the value of _virtualNftReserves instead of _virtualBaseTokenReserves.
